{{Top|ca|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Calamasthon Defiance''' was a group with whom the [[Draag]] criminal [[Slaag Lado]] had ties.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">[[Slaag Lado]]'s [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] appears during [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Mission to Coruscant (The Hunt)|mission to Coruscant]] as part of the [[The Hunt|hunt]] for [[Komari Vosa]] in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the hunt to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Lado was wanted by the [[Mon Calamari Civil Authority]] for allegedly creating a huge [[Groundquake/Legends|seismic]] attack that led to immense environmental damage in the [[Salinrerian Sea]] and resulted in constant [[Water/Legends|rain]] on the site. In the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posted for Lado, the Civil Authority noted the Draag's ties to the Calamasthon Defiance.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Calamasthon Defiance was first mentioned in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''. The organization is mentioned in the bounty information for Slaag Lado, who appears in the game's second chapter, "Lowlifes In High Places."<ref name="BH" />
